{{Quote|We are detecting several Republic tanks moving in on the ridge in front of us.|This droid speaking to TZ-33|<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>}}
A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]]

==Biography==
During the Battle of Felucia around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] was under command of [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]] in a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] outpost. When a team of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] lead by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on the planet to take down the Separatist stronghold, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] informed TZ-33 of their presence and was ordered later on to lower the gate of the facility to allow the droids inside to form up for a counter-attack.

==Behind the scenes==
This B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
